notes: Each probe draws into a fresh invisible 400x300-pixel figure, exports to a temporary path, reports file facts (existence, leading bytes, image size), then deletes the file and closes the figure; errors record the identifier only.

cases.call: f = figure('Visible','off','Units','pixels','Position',[100 100 400 300]); plot(1:3); fn = [tempname '.png']; exportgraphics(gca, fn); report isfile, warning identifier (lastwarn), first bytes and image size; delete fn

cases.description: Append true to an existing pdf grows the file
cases.call: f = figure('Visible','off','Units','pixels','Position',[100 100 400 300]); plot(1:3); fn = [tempname '.pdf']; exportgraphics(gca, fn); n1 = file size; exportgraphics(gca, fn, 'Append', true); n2 = file size; report n2 > n1; delete fn

cases.description: Append true with a png target
cases.call: f = figure('Visible','off','Units','pixels','Position',[100 100 400 300]); plot(1:3); fn = [tempname '.png']; exportgraphics(gca, fn); exportgraphics(gca, fn, 'Append', true); delete fn

cases.description: a second export of different content to the same png path replaces the file
cases.call: f = figure('Visible','off','Units','pixels','Position',[100 100 400 300]); plot(1:3); fn = [tempname '.png']; exportgraphics(gca, fn); b1 = file bytes; cla; plot([3 1 2]); exportgraphics(gca, fn); b2 = file bytes; report isfile and ~isequal(b1, b2); delete fn
f = figure('Visible','off','Units','pixels','Position',[100 100 400 300]); plot(1:3); exportgraphics(gca, fullfile(tempname, 'sub', 'x.png'))
